profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.geoLocationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States
profile.summary:
Hi, my name is Grant Johnson and I'm a Software Engineer with a focus on Full Stack Development. I studied at Cal Poly, SLO where I graduated summa cum laude with a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science.

I decided to enter the software engineering field after taking a programming course while studying aerospace engineering. That course was my first introduction to programming and it felt so natural! I decided to switch my course of study to enter a field that permeates virtually every industry. The possibility of working on technologies across different industries was so exciting to me! 

Every project I work on in my free time is a result of me thinking "man, I wish there was a something that could do that!" I love working on passion projects like these and solving problems we face in everyday life. Now, my primary desire is to contribute on projects that leave a genuine impact on the world.

Feel free to visit my portfolio site to see some of the projects I've worked on thus far.

positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Collaborating with leaders of the WUI FIRE Institute to design and rebuild their website from scratch, achieving a 70% increase in rendering speeds.
- Converted the existing Wordpress site to a Headless CMS in order to provide stakeholders an interface for adding and updating information that they had experience with.
- Worked within Cal Poly University design constraints and adhered to them to create a fully responsive website that delivers a seamless experience across web and mobile devices.

- Developed a new internal test suite generator interface to streamline the test creation and monitoring process for the QA team, complete with Vuelidate form validation.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies Utilized: React, TypeScript, Material UI, MariaDB, SQL, GraphQL, Python
- Adapted metrics from static analytics reports to a collection of dynamic, filter-driven pages to provide electrical utility partners with advanced insights into consumer charging behavior by writing GraphQL/SQL queries with Python post processing to populate customized Chart.js charts.
- Developed a series of interactive, synchronized mixed charts to compare actual energy loads and vehicle plugin times with various counterfactuals to aid the sales team in demonstrating the company's impact.

projects.title: weLynk Event Finder Website
projects.description:
Technologies Utilized: Next.js, MongoDB, OpenLayers, Google Maps API, Pusher, Vercel
- Developed a responsive event finder website for users to create and join local events from an OpenLayers map interface, leveraging Google Maps API calls for location logic.
- Utilized the Pusher API to establish web socket connections for real-time group chats within each individual event page.
- Optimized map interface rendering speeds by restricting processed events to those fitting the user’s filtering constraints and falling within the current viewport.

projects.title: PolyGains Fitness Website
projects.description:
Technologies Utilized: React, Express, Node.js, MongoDB, Azure
- Worked with a small team of students through the design and development of a fitness tracking social media website for Cal Poly Students.
- Implemented a variety of features including account creation, authentication, and customization, friend relationship logic, a responsive workout calendar, and user search autocomplete logic.
- Included Jest unit testing to achieve 100% code coverage of REST API function calls.
